Leadership Is Not Off the Rack

Leadership should be designed—intentional, tailored, and refined over time.

Foundational Experience Standard

Digital coaching reflects founder Tiffany’s Couture Leadership™ methodology: Purpose, Precision, Presence, Tailoring, and Craftsmanship. Digital coaching interactions are never conversations with Tiffany personally. Premium human executive coaching is a distinct service.

Credential Governance

Discovery Milestone

Participation milestone only. Recognizes completion of discovery; it is not a credential or certification.

Level 2: Foundations Credential

Earned through documented achievement of foundations requirements.

Level 3: Advanced Certification

Competency-based, earned through documented demonstration and evaluation.

Credentials are earned through documented achievement and never purchased. Membership or payment alone does not confer a credential.
